machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard `Service health` (listed as "Service Health") contains 3 panels, in order: **Request rate**, **Error count**, **Latency by endpoint**. Verified via panel-header elements (`data-testid="Panel header …"`) and a full accessibility snapshot — no collapsed rows or hidden panels.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** New dashboard **`fwgr58-n1 Bench Dashboard`** created and saved, containing a **Stat** panel titled **`fwgr58-n1 Availability`** whose query uses the **TestData** data source (query row read "A (TestData) — Scenario: Random Walk", the default). Panel JSON confirms `"type": "stat"`. Note: this Grafana build is 11.3.0, whose panel editor has no "Apply" button — the panel was committed via "Back to dashboard" and then the dashboard explicitly saved.

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The dashboard also contains a **Text** panel titled **`fwgr58-n1 Notes`** rendering exactly: **"Notes for run fwgr58-n1 - benchmark dashboard."** (contains the runid). Panel JSON confirms `"type": "text"`. Saved ("Dashboard saved" toast).

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Dashboard tag **`bench`** added via Dashboard settings → Tags (single tag chip, persisted — re-reading the settings page showed the `bench` chip). Time range set to **Last 6 hours** and persisted by ticking the save dialog's **"Update default time range"** checkbox before confirming the save. Persistence proven by reloading the dashboard with no `from`/`to` query params — the picker still read "Last 6 hours".

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Auto-refresh interval set to **`1m`** via the top-bar refresh picker, then persisted by ticking the save drawer's **"Update default refresh value"** checkbox before saving. Persistence proven by reloading with no `?refresh` param — the picker still read "1m" (aria-label "…current interval 1 minute selected").

**Objective 6 — DONE.** URL read from the browser address bar after navigating to the param-free `/d/dfyk9k8j0d3pcf/` and letting the page settle:
**http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/dfyk9k8j0d3pcf/fwgr58-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m**
Dashboard UID: **dfyk9k8j0d3pcf**. (The `from`/`to`/`refresh` params were injected by Grafana itself from the dashboard's saved defaults, not typed — the page first settled at the bare `/d/dfyk9k8j0d3pcf/` URL before Grafana rewrote it, which is itself confirmation the saved defaults are in effect.)

Final state of the dashboard: title `fwgr58-n1 Bench Dashboard`, 2 panels (`fwgr58-n1 Notes` text panel, `fwgr58-n1 Availability` stat panel), tag `bench`, time range Last 6 hours, auto-refresh 1m — all saved.
